title: Real backend and isolated browser regression execution

cases.title: Persistence, controls, recovery, provenance, isolation, browser and Hub regressions
cases.expected: All selected tests pass, including the eight real-server browser tests, with no skipped browser tests
cases.observed: 109 test executions; exit 0; no skipped tests
cases.evidence: Exact test names and results in software-tests.log; behavioral expectations are executable in test_core.py, test_validation.py and test_ui.py.

limitations: Scientific records in automated browser tests are explicitly synthetic fixtures; real research is evaluated in separate artifacts.
HTTPTests also executes inherited store tests, so execution count is not a count of independent scientific or behavioral claims.

Ruff and Node executables were unavailable. No repository linter/build is configured for this stdlib/static application; Python compile checks and actual Playwright JavaScript/CSP execution were used instead.
